name: Guernsey
prevalence_note: Guernsey Post runs a dedicated scam-text page warning about fake parcel messages, and the States of Guernsey revenue service publishes tax guidance relevant to fake tax approaches.
cross_border_note: Guernsey uses UK numbering (+44, area code 01481), so UK-origin scam calls and texts reach islanders exactly like mainland UK numbers.

scams.name: Fake Guernsey Post text
scams.name_en: Text impersonating Guernsey Post asking for a fee or details
scams.signals_en: A text claiming to be Guernsey Post says a parcel needs a fee or redelivery details and links to a lookalike page.
scams.legit_en: Guernsey Post's scam-text page warns about these fake texts; parcels should be checked only on Guernsey Post's own site.
bait_tactics: Ask whether the parcel is at Envoy House or a myEBOX point, then ask again
Say the card is in a drawer upstairs and ask for a reference to quote at the counter

scams.name: Fake Revenue Service request
scams.name_en: Fake Guernsey tax or social-security request for data or payment
scams.signals_en: A message or call presents itself as Guernsey's tax office and asks for bank details to issue a refund or pay arrears.
scams.legit_en: Tax matters are handled through the States of Guernsey's official tax portal, not by unsolicited calls asking for bank data.
bait_tactics: Ask for the tax reference and which year it relates to, slowly
Say the tax adviser in St Peter Port deals with every revenue letter
